acceptance_evidence: AC1, a decision record with model, question, probabilities, threshold and outcome: record 29 is one, taken live from jev-1.13.0, rating this ticket's own risk medium at 0.65 with a score of 1.31 and a confidence of 0.48
AC2, advance from clarify refused below the threshold, naming what it judged on: test_advance_from_clarify_is_refused_below_the_threshold and test_the_refusal_quotes_the_probability_it_judged_on
AC3, a billing or policy-gate change adds the checklist and a second reviewer: test_a_billing_or_policy_gate_ticket_needs_a_second_reviewer

AC4, with no credential every decision point records the fallback and continues: records 11 and 19 of this journal carry unavailable decisions, and records 21 and 22 are human answers, record 22 naming the API failure it fell back from

AC5, the credential is read from .env.local first and never reaches a record: test_the_credential_is_read_from_the_env_file_before_the_environment and test_no_decision_record_holds_the_credential_or_any_environment_value, the latter against an API that echoes the whole environment back
The contract itself: one request carries every question a stage owns, proven by test_one_request_carries_every_question_a_stage_owns and by the live call at record 29

findings.claim: The whole integration was written against a service that does not exist: thejevai.com is the playground, not the API
findings.failure_scenario: Every decision in the MVP falls back to a human while appearing integrated, and the harness reports 401s that look like a credential problem and are not. Two valid credentials were blamed before the endpoint was
findings.resolution: Corrected to api.typesafe.ai/v1/systemone with model jev-latest from the published API reference, the ticket and workflow.md corrected at the source, and verified with a live call recorded at record 29. The receipt that attested the wrong implementation was voided at record 26 rather than patched over

findings.claim: The answer shapes were invented: a noul returns one probability, not an answer plus a distribution, and a score returns level indices with a legend and a confidence
findings.failure_scenario: The first real call parses into empty probabilities and an outcome of None, every threshold comparison silently reads 0.0, and every gate either refuses everything or passes everything
findings.resolution: Rewritten against the published shapes with a red at 27 and a green at 28. The level index maps back to the option name, so records still read low, medium, high and blocking rather than 0, 1 and 2

findings.claim: Questions carried no criteria, so the model was given a bare question and no rubric
findings.failure_scenario: Risk and severity scores drift, because nothing says what medium means for this project, and the recorded probabilities cannot be compared between tickets
findings.resolution: Every question now carries criteria in the API's own format: true and false descriptions for a noul, an ordered level description for a score, written in this project's terms

security_checklist: No secret in the diff: .env.local is gitignored and the credential is read, never recorded
A test proves an API echoing the environment back cannot get any of it into the journal
No new dependency: urllib from the standard library
No test can reach the live API: the test base strips the credential and nulls the transport
The one live call in this ticket was deliberate, authorised at clarify, and carries only this ticket's own record as state
